_schema.description: Per-species constants read out of the Animal Population Scanner exe. One object per species record (struct size 0x3C0, array VA 0x1400B08C0..0x1400CED70, 126 live records).

record_layout.+0x00: i32 stringId -> index into the runtime localization table (English names in notes/localization-en.json)
record_layout.+0x1C: f32[3] ascending per-species triple (semantics not proven)
record_layout.+0x30: f32[8] ascending series, zero-padded; magnitude matches species body weight in kg

confidence.maxDifficultyRating: LIKELY (magnitudes and known COTW ratings agree)
